content.title: When is the Boston Marathon? How to watch it on TV and stream it
content.text: April 17, 2026, 9:40 a.m. ETThe Boston Marathon is coming up fast.It will be the 130th annual race and is set to host over 30,000 competitors from almost 130 countries, with entrants from all 50 states in the country predicted to participate, the Boston Athletic Association said.If you want to see the Boston Marathon runners pass by in person, the Boston Marathon spectator guide has tips on the best places to watch.If you prefer to experience the marathon from a remote distance, here's how to watch the Boston Marathon, with information from the Boston Athletic Association.What day is the 2026 Boston Marathon?The 130th Boston Marathon is on Monday, April 20, 2026, which is also Patriot’s Day. It’s also known as Marathon Monday.The Boston Marathon is traditionally held on Patriot’s Day, which is the third Monday in April. This year, the marathon falls on the 251st anniversary of Patriot’s Day.What time is the Boston Marathon?People start arriving for the Boston Marathon early in the morning, but the times the actual races start varies.These are the start times for athletes competing in the day's races, according to the Athletic Association:Men’s Wheelchair 9:06 a.m. ETWomen’s Wheelchair 9:09 a.m. ETHandcycle & Duo Participants 9:30 a.m. ETProfessional Men 9:37 a.m. ETProfessional Women 9:47 a.m. ETPara Athletics Divisions 9:50 a.m. ETWave 1 10 a.m. ETWave 2 10:25 a.m. ETWave 3 10:50 a.m. ETWave 4 11:15 a.m. ETHow long is the Boston Marathon?The Boston Marathon is the standard marathon length of 26.2 miles.The marathon traces its roots to ancient Greece. According to legend, Pheidippides ran from the plains of Marathon to Athens to deliver the news that the Greek Army had won a crucial battle against the invading Persian Army.“Rejoice, we are victorious,” he announced before falling dead. While his run was only 24.8 miles, it became the story behind the modern Olympic Marathon. The marathon distance was lengthened to 26.2 miles to suit the wishes of the British royal family in the 1908 Olympic Games and this distance became the Olympic standard in 1924.When does the Boston Marathon end?That depends on exactly what you're asking.The finish line closes 5:30 p.m., according to the Boston Athletic Association. However, not every runner will have crossed the finish line at that point. Runners still on the course are asked to move to the sidewalk to finish. Roads are typically reopening along the route as the majority of the runners pass through.But if what you're asking it when to the elite runners finish, that's much earlier. For the elite runners, which have staggered start times, the men typically finish around 11:45 and the women around 12:10.Where does Boston Marathon end?The race ends in Boston's Back Bay, with a stretch down Boylston Street. The finish line is between the Fairfield and Dartmouth Street intersections, near Boston Public Library and Copley Square.What is the qualifying time for the Boston Marathon? How long does it take runners?The Boston Marathon is a fast race, and the qualifying times reflect that.Here are the qualifying times for the 2026 Boston Marathon.Age GroupMENWOMENNON-BINARY18-342hrs 55min3hrs 25min3hrs 25min35-393hrs 00min3hrs 30min3hrs 30min40-443hrs 05min3hrs 35min3hrs 35min45-493hrs 15min3hrs 45min3hrs 45min50-543hrs 20min3hrs 50min3hrs 50min55-593hrs 30min4hrs 00min4hrs 00min60-643hrs 50min4hrs 20min4hrs 20min65-694hrs 05min4hrs 35min4hrs 35min70-744hrs 20min4hrs 50min4hrs 50min75-794hrs 35min5hrs 05min5hrs 05min80 and over4hrs 50min5hrs 20min5hrs 20minHow to watch the Boston Marathon: LocalWCVB Channel 5 (ABC) will be covering the Boston Marathon live for all Boston-area viewers beginning at 4 a.m. on Marathon Monday.It will be simulcast regionally on its sister stations: WMUR News 9 ABC (Manchester, NH), WMTW Channel 8 ABC (Portland/Auburn, ME), and WPTZ NBC5 (Burlington, VT/Plattsburgh, NY).Local viewers can also live stream the marathon on the Very Local app.How to watch the Boston Marathon: NationalESPN2 will provide live national coverage of the Boston Marathon from 9 a.m. ET until 12:30 p.m. ET, as well as some other coverage on other ESPN shows and platforms before and after that time.
